mapper.sql: id, item_id, lydwh, lydwm, zcbhqj, zcflh, zcmc, ppxh, gg, sl, dj, je, jldw, cj, ggrq, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT epa.id, epa.item_id, epa.lydwh, epa.lydwm, epa.zcbhqj, epa.zcflh, epa.zcmc, epa.ppxh, epa.gg, epa.sl, epa.dj, epa.je, epa.jldw, epa.cj, epa.ggrq, epa.created_at FROM equipment_pending_audit epa INNER JOIN contract_items ci ON epa.item_id = ci.id WHERE ci.contract_id = #{contractId}
